attributes.title: Milk Production and Dairy Development in Africa: A Practical Guide for Smallholder Farmers

body.value: This open educational resource covers the fundamentals of milk production, dairy herd management, and smallholder dairy enterprise development in sub-Saharan Africa. Topics include breed selection, feeding strategies, milking hygiene, milk handling, and marketing of dairy products.
body.summary: A practical guide covering milk production, herd management, and dairy enterprise development for smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa.

field_authors_names: FAO Animal Production and Health Division

attributes.title: Hygienic Milk Handling and Processing: A Training Manual for African Dairy Cooperatives

body.value: This manual provides training content on hygienic collection, cooling, transport, and processing of milk for dairy cooperatives in Africa. It addresses the key microbial hazards in raw milk, good hygiene practices at the farm and collection centre levels, and simple processing techniques suitable for small-scale dairy enterprises.
body.summary: Training manual on hygienic milk handling, cooling, transport, and processing for dairy cooperatives in Africa.

attributes.title: Nutrition and Human Health: Understanding the Role of Milk and Dairy in the African Diet

body.value: This open textbook examines the nutritional composition of milk and dairy foods, their contribution to human health, and strategies for improving dietary diversity and nutrition security in African communities through increased access to dairy. It includes discussion of lactose intolerance, traditional fermented dairy products, and fortification approaches.
body.summary: Open textbook on the nutritional role of milk and dairy in the African diet, covering health benefits, fermented products, and nutrition security.

meta.field_institution_title: University of Nairobi, Department of Food Science and Nutrition

attributes.title: Dairy Cattle Breeding and Milk Yield Improvement in East Africa

body.value: This resource provides an overview of dairy cattle breeds suited to East African conditions, selection criteria for improving milk yield, crossbreeding strategies, and the role of national breeding programmes. It is intended for use in veterinary and agricultural science courses at African universities and technical colleges.
body.summary: Overview of dairy cattle breeds, selection criteria, crossbreeding strategies, and national breeding programmes for milk yield improvement in East Africa.

meta.field_institution_title: Kenya Agricultural and Livestock Research Organization

attributes.title: Fermented Milk Products of Africa: Traditional Knowledge and Modern Applications

body.value: This book documents the diversity of traditional fermented milk products found across Africa, including amasi, mursik, suusac, and leben, exploring their cultural significance, microbiology, nutritional properties, and potential for commercialisation. It draws on both traditional knowledge and contemporary food science to provide a comprehensive reference for students, researchers, and food entrepreneurs.
body.summary: Documentation of traditional African fermented milk products—their cultural significance, microbiology, nutritional properties, and commercial potential.
